segments.note: I should probably gatekeep this, but the best job on the market might just be an oyster farmer.
We flew down to North Carolina and you could lease nine acres of ocean for under a thousand bucks a year.
And the day consists of swimming around (first take; the repeated 'and the day consists of' at 23.8-25.0 is dropped)
eating oysters, and getting in the water. (0.4 s pause after 'sun' removed)
This is hard to beat. We're giving away oysters from this farm. If you want to win them, comment oysters and I'll send you the link. (second take; first take 32.8-35.9 abandoned mid-CTA)
